channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Copilot code review: API management and review overview updates
item.description: GitHub Copilot code review settings can now be managed via REST and GraphQL APIs from enterprise policy down to individual repositories, while its review overview comment is more compact and fixes target billing, automatic reviews, and reliability. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Beyond code generation: A developer’s guide to agentic engineering
item.description: GitHub sees over 1.2 billion commits weekly, up more than 400% year over year, while Faros AI reports high-AI-adoption teams spend 441% longer reviewing PRs; this guide maps GitHub Copilot across Plan, Build, Verify and Observe for agentic engineering. (GitHub AI & ML)

item.title: Copilot impact dashboard adds chat and VS Code agent usage
item.description: The Copilot impact dashboard's Agent adoption chart now covers nine Copilot experiences including Copilot Chat and the VS Code Agents window, renames "Passive users" to "Chat-first users," and updates 28-day usage reporting. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — November 2
item.description: GitHub Copilot arrives in JetBrains Air and Xcode's coding assistant, with the Xcode integration in public beta from 27.3 beta, alongside a unified /settings dashboard for plugins and MCP servers and new Agent Merge pull-request tools. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: @GitHub in Slack and Teams is generally available and more
item.description: @GitHub in Slack and Teams is now generally available, letting teams investigate bugs, create issues, implement changes and open pull requests inside conversations, while Teams' Canvas supports reviewing implementation plans, code changes and previews. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: GPT‑6 Cyber — OpenAI’s cyber model, with vetted access for defenders
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber page promises vetted access for defenders, but the source returns a 403 Forbidden bot-verification screen with no readable model details, specifications or access terms. (Product Hunt)

item.title: dsx-ai-factory/nvke — NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE). A management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal.
item.description: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) is a management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal that lets platform teams create per-customer workload clusters, each with its own control plane, etcd and node pools, though the preview explicitly is not recommended for production. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Microsoft Researcher John Langford Exits. AI Frontiers Group Declared Finished
item.description: John Langford has left Microsoft and declared the roughly 50-person AI Frontiers finished after the group moved into Microsoft AI in September, saying agent research is hard to deploy under a scaling-heavy focus.

item.title: Google acquires Crusoe data center site in southeastern Wyoming
item.description: Google has acquired Crusoe’s southeast Wyoming data center site after Crusoe completed site selection, approvals, and a hybrid power strategy combining fuel cells, grid power, and natural gas turbines with Tallgrass Energy. (www.crusoe.ai)

item.title: Components of Agent Memory
item.description: Claude uses dreaming to review logs during idle time and correct mistakes, drawing on Letta and UC Berkeley's sleep-time compute to distinguish agent memory from in-context learning and compaction. (www.anthropic.com)

item.title: Every Mac ships with an undocumented family-member recognizer
item.description: Every Mac ships with an undocumented family-member recognizer (8rank.ai)

item.title: AI is dramatically accelerating AI research
item.description: A METR report on AI R&D acceleration at Anthropic finds capability progress from October 2025 to October 2026 was roughly twice the prior 12 months, which the author says crosses the RSP's drastic acceleration threshold. (www.planned-obsolescence.org)

item.title: Show HN: We compressed a 31B video+audio diffusion model to 14B, 6 steps, INT8
item.description: Video Rebirth compressed MiniMax-H3 into 13.7B HyperFlow H3 Flash, generating video and synchronized stereo audio in 4–8 steps with INT8/GGUF builds, including GGUF on 64GB-RAM PCs and INT8 on 24GB+ RTX GPUs with 69GiB system memory.

item.title: Firecracker VM Escape: PwnEscape Part Two
item.description: A malicious Firecracker guest in PwnEscape Part 2 used a host memory primitive to locate the live VMM, tamper with a vCPU thread’s pt_regs, and hijack a root host process when KVM_RUN returned, chaining CVE-2026-99999 into guest-to-host code execution. (pwn.ai)

item.title: ChatGPT silently passes data between connectors and the bounty wants an ID card
item.description: With two connectors enabled, ChatGPT silently routed a follow-up tool call through Connector B rather than Connector A, which started the flow; the call carried a one-time confirmation code and the user was never told, exposing cross-OAuth data-transfer risk.

item.title: SketchAgentBench – evaluate LLMs on 3D spatial reasoning
item.description: SketchAgentBench tests 11 models across 25 photos and 275 runs, having them write code to build 3D scenes, inspect rendered views, and refine geometry, with each run scored on its final 3D scene.

item.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI's systems – OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI and Hacktron will jointly test high-priority areas of OpenAI's systems, focusing on how they interact with third-party services, while expanding Hacktron's access to frontier models through Daybreak Red.
